exposure: previous cesarean section scar characteristics (Vancouver Scar Scale)
outcome: intra-abdominal adhesions (Modified Tulandi and Lyell classification)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 155 pregnant women with at least one prior cesarean section, admitted for repeat cesarean delivery.
finding: Preoperative assessment of abdominal striae, previous cesarean scar quality, and the ultrasound sliding sign provides an effective triad for predicting uterine adhesions in women undergoing repeat cesarean sections.
mod_finding: The incidence of intra-abdominal adhesions significantly increased with the number of previous cesarean sections.
